title: Differential abundance between two groups of spots
summary: Which features sit at different levels between a spatial group and its sibling, with a permutation calibrated cutoff.

third_party.name: HypothesisTests.jl
third_party.note: Supplies MannWhitneyUTest. The test statistic comes from this package, so its version is part of the scientific surface. Resolved from kernels/tumorspace_core/julia/Manifest.toml.

third_party.name: julia
third_party.note: Read from the image. Manifest.toml records 1.9.0, so the lockfile and the runtime disagree; the image is what executes. The RNG stream is a language guarantee, so this matters under a fixed seed.

environment.provenance: Digest read from the build on randi dated 2026-07-02. The recipe cannot regenerate it: build_r_container.sh resolves CRAN against 'latest' rather than a dated snapshot, so this file is currently the only record of the versions below.

inputs.name: sg_pairs
inputs.description: Which node is contrasted against which sibling set.

inputs.name: sg_pair_members
inputs.description: Which spots belong to each side of each pair.

inputs.name: matrix
inputs.description: Spots by features. Any feature space works: genes and cell type proportions are both used in practice.

inputs.name: observations
inputs.description: Row labels for the matrix, header 'barcode'.

inputs.name: features
inputs.description: Column labels for the matrix. Named genes.txt for historical reasons; the cell type run puts cell type names here under the header 'cell_type'.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Every feature tested, with both group means, a p value, and a significance label.

outputs.name: significant
outputs.description: The subset passing the permutation cutoff. This is the file the cohort layer reads.

outputs.name: counts_by_node
outputs.description: How many features passed per pair.

parameters.name: num_shuffle
parameters.description: Permutations used to calibrate the cutoff. The significance column is written as the literal string '< 1/num_shuffle', and downstream consumers match that string exactly, so changing this value silently breaks them.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Makes the permutations reproducible. Left unset in production runs.

determinism.note: Permutations draw from the global RNG. Unseeded runs do not reproduce, so any before and after comparison of a refactor has to set the seed on both sides.

resources.scales_with: features x pairs x (num_shuffle + 1) rank sum tests
resources.memory_hint: 32 GB is what the orchestrator requests. Memory is driven by the matrix, cost by the test count.

interpretation:
Significance here is the pipeline's own permutation calibrated cutoff, which is a stricter and different criterion than a false discovery rate. It is reported as the pipeline gave it and is never recomputed, so these values must not be set against a q value from another tool, and a count of significant features is not comparable to a count produced under an FDR.

Every comparison is a spatial group against the pooled remainder of its own split, within one sample, so a feature significant in two samples is two separate findings rather than a replication.
for_people: Finds which genes sit at different levels in one spatial group than in its sibling.
